title: Casper and the Vow
author: Felix Voss
blurb: Noor Reyes, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
